ctl_help.stdout:
Usage:
  supervisord [OPTIONS] ctl [ctl-OPTIONS] <command>

The ctl subcommand resembles supervisorctl command of original daemon.

Application Options:
  -c, --configuration= the configuration file
  -d, --daemon         run as daemon
      --env-file=      the environment file

Help Options:
  -h, --help           Show this help message

[ctl command options]
      -s, --serverurl= URL on which supervisord server is listening
      -u, --user=      the user name
      -P, --password=  the password
      -v, --verbose    Show verbose debug information

Available commands:
  logtail   get the standard output&standard error of the program
  pid       get the pid of specified program
  reload    reload the programs
  restart   restart programs
  shutdown  shutdown supervisord
  signal    send signal to program
  start     start programs
  status    show program status
  stop      stop programs
